# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_016_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 16

**1** Jesus said: "People may think I came to bring peace to the world. They have no idea — I came to bring division: fire, sword, war.

**2** Five people in a house will split apart: three against two, two against three, father against son, son against father.

**3** And in the end they will stand alone."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "They have no idea" — the negation rendered emphatically
- "Split apart" — the division rendered as active fragmentation
- "In the end they will stand alone" — the *monachos* rendered as the eventual outcome; the solitary standing is the resolution
